verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a cloud file-storage service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of choosing a storage region or residency. The phrase "no matter where they are stored" is about access, not residency, and community comments about default save locations concern local versus cloud saving, not geographic residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
